name: proc-stats
description: Status line and task-manager pane with Claude Code's memory, CPU and uptime, and those of the processes it started

intervalLinuxMs.title: Refresh on Linux (ms)
intervalLinuxMs.description: How often processes are read on Linux; 250 to 60000.

intervalMacMs.title: Refresh on macOS (ms)
intervalMacMs.description: How often processes are read on macOS; 250 to 60000.

intervalWindowsMs.title: Refresh on Windows (ms)
intervalWindowsMs.description: How often processes are read on Windows; 1000 to 60000. Each read starts PowerShell.

warnMemMb.title: Memory warning (MB)
warnMemMb.description: 🟡 on the status line when Claude Code and its processes use more memory than this.

alertMemMb.title: Memory alert (MB)
alertMemMb.description: 🔴 on the status line above this.

warnCpuPct.title: CPU warning (%)
warnCpuPct.description: 🟡 when the session's CPU, averaged over 10 s, is above this (100 = one core).

toastCpuPct.title: Busy process CPU (%)
toastCpuPct.description: A toast when one child process stays above this CPU…

toastMemMb.title: Large process memory (MB)
toastMemMb.description: A toast when one child process grows past this.

historyMinutes.title: History (minutes)
historyMinutes.description: How far back the pane's sparklines reach; 1 to 120.

statusShowChildren.title: Child processes on the status line
statusShowChildren.description: Show the + part for processes Claude Code started.
